html:
SMTO-MON-0004 — SMTO couldn't use a model to plan this monitor

GUID: fab576a6-1711-4189-99ed-475a0f1ea9be
Slug: monitor-model-unavailable
Domain: MON · Subsystem: mon

What happened

  • SMTO tried to turn your description into a monitor but had no working model connection for that planning step, so it couldn't work out the monitor from your words.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask again with the exact command in backticks, for example: monitor df -h every 60 seconds for 10 minutes. With a command in backticks, SMTO builds the monitor without needing a model to plan it.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and check that the Main model is set up and working. If a Helper model is set, check that one too, because monitor planning uses it first. Monitor planning uses the Helper model, or the Main model when no Helper is set, and without a working one SMTO can't plan from plain words.
  3. Send a short message in a conversation to confirm the model replies, then ask for the monitor again. A normal reply shows the model connection is working again.

What success looks like

  • SMTO proposes or starts the monitor instead of showing this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete saved monitors or turn off safety checks to get past this; they aren't the cause.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Semantic monitor planning (llm_monitor_spec) found no callable complete_json on the configured drafting model client.

What this means

  • Semantic planning inspects llm_client.complete_json and finds no callable implementation. Monitor validation does not execute the observation command. Existing monitor state and stored observations remain authoritative; missing planning support or exhausted judgment budget does not prove observation collection failed.

Why this can happen

  • Semantic planning inspects llm_client.complete_json and finds no callable implementation.

How to diagnose it

  • Check runtime client wiring and method support; this local check does not prove endpoint or credential failure.

How to fix it

  • Ensure the monitor drafting client (scheduled_auxiliary_client role monitor_draft, configured through Model routing) exposes complete_json, or supply an explicit backticked command so deterministic drafting is used. AOR_MONITOR_DRAFTING_ENABLED controls model drafting; see src/agent_runtime/monitors/drafting.py.
  • Restore a compatible runtime model client for monitor planning, or supply a supported explicit monitor command.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The configured planning client exposes the supported structured completion interface.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Monitor validation does not execute the observation command. Existing monitor state and stored observations remain authoritative; missing planning support or exhausted judgment budget does not prove observation collection failed.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
